title: [review] duty_cycle.rs: usage_permille can truncate above 65535 permille
description: Cast to u16 at line 390 truncates if (used * 1000 / WINDOW_MS) exceeds 65535. While legitimate usage caps at ~1000 permille, malformed or adversarial record_tx calls with huge durations could cause total_tx_in_window to return values that produce permille > 65535, yielding incorrect congestion levels. Consider saturating to 1000 or using u32 internally.
